latest.title: Taming Sensor Noise: Rolling-Window Sensor Fusion on Microcontrollers
latest.description:
An accelerometer spike is the cheapest crash or fall trigger, and also the least reliable. Potholes, dropped devices, and loose mounts all produce spikes that look like emergencies, and every false alert costs you user trust. The fix is to treat the spike as a candidate and confirm it with other sensors before anything reaches the cloud.
This article shows how to do that on an ESP32 with FreeRTOS and send only confirmed events to AWS IoT Core.
